title: Parallel IPv6 and IPv4 downloading

title: Downloading aborted for individual connection results in download still complete but with corrupted file
evidence: The ported 206-without-Content-Range rejection lacked the getSegment() guard and hard-failed a legitimate segment-less unknown-length response. Fixed. Final pass also validates transfer-encoded responses carrying Content-Range and rejects segmented transfer-encoded 200/206 without it, closing the wrong-range and ignored-range corruption bypasses.

title: Getting several errorCode=8 Invalid range header results

title: No retries on SSL errors
evidence: Confirmed: the client-side handshake-failure reclassification to DL_RETRY_EX is backend-neutral (above TLSSession) and reaches AbstractCommand's retry path on all shipped backends; server side still aborts. #1794's unknown-version abort is removed and reachable; the two WinTLS regressions it rode in with (min-tls-version no-op and dropped strong-crypto) are fixed by this branch. Caveat: permanent cert failures are also retried (widening of existing behaviour).

The original unsupported checksum feature remains open without the integrity-state regression.

title: min-tls-version=TLSv1.3 fails on Windows
test_ref: test/WinTLSProtocolsTest.cc (3 cases + obsolete protocol assertions); mingw cross-compile parity
evidence: DEFECT: modern-Schannel AND-ed ~SP_PROT into a zero grbitDisabledProtocols mask (stays 0 = no floor), so --min-tls-version was a no-op. Rewritten: winTLSDisabledProtocols() builds the blacklist and explicitly disables PCT/SSL so the minimum is not weakened by machine policy; host-unit-tested (RED vs original bit logic).

title: "Loop range missing/overflow" error due to ridiculously small data type
evidence: The port added an RPC-reachable divide-by-zero and a %d/int64_t format mismatch. Fixed. Final pass bounds aggregate choice/range expansion at 65,536 strings, so inputs such as [0-2147483647] fail before reserve/allocation instead of causing process OOM.
